name: Melanocyte MITF-M program for pigmentation
rationale: All members concern the melanocyte MITF-M lineage program; unlike confusables (MITF-M cell cycle, DNA repair, apoptosis), this theme carries pigment synthesis, pigment granule localization, melanocyte differentiation and UV/light response.

name: Salt and water homeostasis under osmotic stress
rationale: Members are ion cotransporters, K+ channels and Na/Cl/Mg/water homeostasis; the osmosensory, hyperosmotic, hypotonic and salt-stress responses set it apart from confusables focused on P-type ATPases/aldosterone, K2P channels or Na/H exchangers.

name: Early secretory pathway with COPII export
rationale: Members span SRP/tail-anchored/multi-pass protein insertion into the ER and COPII cargo loading and ER-to-Golgi transport; confusables instead carry ER folding, ERAD, COPI retrograde traffic or connexin transport.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling with SERCA reuptake
rationale: Members regulate ER/SR Ca2+ release (ryanodine, caffeine) and clearance of cytosolic Ca2+; regulation of ATPase-coupled Ca2+ import into the SR distinguishes it from release-focused and cardiac confusables.

name: Erythroid differentiation, terminal red-cell membrane remodeling
rationale: Most members are erythroid differentiation terms and erythroid gene modules (one TAK1-ATF module is peripheral); the terminal membrane/cytoskeleton and enucleation modules separate it from megakaryocyte and stem-cell-level confusables.

name: Urea cycle arginine synthesis with OTC deficiency
rationale: All members concern urea-cycle citrulline/arginine synthesis; the OTC variant deficiencies distinguish it from confusables carrying urea-cycle regulation, ornithine/ammonium metabolism or other enzyme deficiencies.

qualifier: of fungi and bacteria by effector proteins
name: Antimicrobial protein killing of fungi and bacteria
rationale: Members are host killing of microbes (antifungal humoral response, Gram-positive defense, cytolysis, metal sequestration, neutrophil cytotoxicity); confusables instead carry respiratory burst, degranulation or iron assimilation.

name: Hexose assimilation and glycogen turnover defects
rationale: Members cover intestinal/renal hexose uptake and glycogen synthesis/breakdown, largely as inborn errors; glycogen storage diseases separate it from hexose-absorption confusables and absorption/transport separates it from glycolysis/gluconeogenesis confusables.

name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signaling and its cancer mutants
rationale: All members are TGF-beta/BMP/activin/AMH receptor-SMAD signaling or its regulators (TGFBR3, RUNX3); the TGFBR/SMAD cancer mutant set distinguishes it from confusables lacking them.

qualifier: in both T and B cells
name: Antigen-receptor co-signaling in both T and B cells
rationale: Members are TCR/BCR proximal signaling and co-stimulatory/co-inhibitory receptors (CD28, CTLA4, BTLA, CD22); inclusion of BCR signaling separates it from T-cell-only confusables.

name: Epithelial solute carrier uptake, chiefly amino acids
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane SLC transport of amino acids, peptides, urate and sugars with their aminoacidurias; neutral amino acid and peptide carriers distinguish it from hexose, organic-cation and cationic-amino-acid confusables.

qualifier: by endothelial and smooth muscle cells
name: Blood vessel remodeling by endothelial and smooth muscle cells
rationale: Members regulate VEGF/Tie angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and phenotypic switching; combining both cell types separates it from endothelial-only and smooth-muscle-only confusables.

name: Amino acid metabolism including tyrosine catabolism
rationale: All members are amino acid metabolic and catabolic processes; tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism distinguishes it from confusables centred on threonine or organic-acid metabolism.

name: Osteoblast differentiation from mesenchymal progenitors, RUNX2-driven
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation with Wnt and BMP inputs; RUNX2 regulation separates it from chondrocyte, osteoclast and collagen confusables.

name: B cell development and activation via BCR signaling
rationale: Members are B cell development, proliferation, homeostasis and activation modules; the BCR signaling cascade (BTK, CD22, RAS) distinguishes it from confusables of B cell surface signatures and plasma cells.

name: MECP2 neuronal gene regulation via HDAC corepressors
rationale: Most members are MECP2 regulation and its Rett-associated loss-of-function and target genes; NCoR/SMRT binding and histone deacetylation distinguish it from behaviour-heavy confusables.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription control at termination
rationale: Members regulate Pol II initiation, elongation and termination (with loosely related gene-expression modules); termination and R-loop processing distinguish it from elongation-, RNA-processing- and chromatin-centred confusables.

name: Cardiac excitation-contraction coupling by sarcoplasmic calcium release
rationale: Members regulate release and clearance of sequestered Ca2+ controlling cardiac contraction, relaxation and rate; cardiac outputs separate it from SERCA-focused confusables and release regulation from inotropic confusables.

name: p53 transcriptional induction of mitochondrial apoptosis
rationale: Members are TP53 transcription of death genes and PUMA/NOXA BH3-only activation leading to cytochrome c release; the TP53 transcriptional arm distinguishes it from BAX/BAK and anoikis confusables.

name: Ovarian follicle cycle including corpus luteum
rationale: All members concern follicle growth, oocyte maturation, ovulation and the estrous cycle; luteinization and luteolysis distinguish it from gonadotropin-centred confusables.

name: Plasma membrane amino acid transport with Hartnup disorder
rationale: All members are plasma-membrane amino acid transporters and their defects; SLC6A19 Hartnup and SLC1A1/SLC6A14 variants distinguish it from iminoglycinuria- and peptide-transport confusables.

name: Centrosome-anchored microtubule organization for spindle orientation
rationale: Members concern centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation/anchoring and spindle assembly; spindle orientation and asymmetric division distinguish it from mitotic-centrosome and cytokinesis confusables.

name: Plasma membrane protein delivery via endocytic recycling
rationale: Members regulate endocytic and receptor recycling, endosome-to-surface transport and constitutive secretion; recycling to the surface distinguishes it from Golgi-endosome-lysosome retrograde confusables.

name: Cardiac muscle adaptation including heart rate and force
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, hypertrophy and contractility; positive control of heart rate and contractile force separates it from the calcineurin-hypertrophy confusable, and cardiac focus from smooth-muscle confusables.

name: Golgi ribbon organization and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members govern Golgi assembly, disassembly, positioning and budding; membrane tubulation distinguishes it from COPI-traffic confusables and Golgi disassembly/reassembly from secretory confusables.

name: DNA base damage repair including direct alkylation reversal
rationale: Members are base excision repair steps, glycosylase defects and alkylation repair; ALKBH/MGMT direct reversal distinguishes it from BER/mismatch/crosslink confusables.

name: Rho and CDC42 GTPase cycles with formin activation
rationale: All members are Rho-family GTPase cycles and signaling; RHOA/B/C plus CDC42/RHOG with formin effectors distinguish it from confusables centred on RAC, RND or ROCK/PAK.

name: Bilirubin clearance and inherited hyperbilirubinemia
rationale: Members cover heme degradation, hepatic organic anion uptake, glucuronidation and biliary export of bilirubin with their defects; bilirubin specificity separates it from drug ADME confusables.

name: Imino acid and glycine transport defects
rationale: All three members are SLC6A20/SLC36A2 defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria, which no confusable contains.

name: Motor coordination behavior with cerebellar development
rationale: Members are locomotion, proprioception, motor learning and cerebellar/striatal development (one neural RNA-binding module); cerebellar layer formation and motor learning distinguish it from vocal and sensory behaviour confusables.
